citations.title: Agents and AI | Paddle Developer Docs
excerpts: Paddle's AI tools (the Paddle MCP server, Docs MCP server, and Agent Skills) let AI agents like Claude and Cursor integrate with, operate, and reason about your Paddle account and docs.
* • Combine the docs MCP server (how Paddle works), the Paddle MCP server (actions in your account), and Agent Skills (step-by-step integration patterns) for best results.
* • Agents ask for your approval before executing account changes by default, so you can review, request changes, or decline before anything happens.
* • Every docs page is available as Markdown by appending .md to the URL, and /llms.txt indexes all pages for AI clients.

What is the Paddle MCP server and how do I connect it to Claude or Cursor? How do Agent Skills help a coding agent write Paddle integration code? What is the difference between the Docs MCP server and the Paddle MCP server?

Connect AI agents like Claude and Cursor directly to Paddle to work through complex flows in seconds. Build pricing models, investigate failed payments, integrate Paddle features, or process customer refunds — all in natural language.
## AI tools

[Paddle MCP server Lets AI agents read data and take actions in your Paddle account.](https://developer.paddle.com/sdks/ai/paddle-mcp) [Docs MCP server Give AI agents full up-to-date knowledge of Paddle.](https://developer.paddle.com/sdks/ai/docs-mcp) [Agent skills Drop-in instructions that teach coding agents how to integrate Paddle.](https://developer.paddle.com/sdks/ai/agent-skills)

Use them together: the docs MCP server tells the agent how Paddle works, the Paddle MCP server lets it take actions in your account, and Agent Skills give coding agents the step-by-step patterns they need to write correct Paddle integration code.
